rationale: The first half hour after 09:30 sets the day's opening range, and when price breaks it on above-normal volume the break comes from real order flow, so the side that broke carries the morning; the main setting is how long after the range is set the break may still be taken. Losing side: Traders who fade the first break of the half-hour opening range and are stopped as heavy volume pushes it on.

filter.plain: only when the bar that just closed has more volume than the median of the same clock bar over the 14 days before
